articles.title: Instagram cracks down on growing ‘pervert glasses’ problem with Meta Ray-Bans
articles.content: Some people fear heights. Others fear the dark. These would be the same Ray-Ban Meta glasses that Mark Zuckerberg has spent years pitching as one of AI's first breakout consumer products. It turns out the glasses can answer questions, translate language, capture photos, livestream hands-free—and record videos surreptitiously. The trend has fueled privacy concerns around the glasses and earned them an unflattering nickname online: "pervert glasses."
